assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, structural systems, fire access and engineering constraints are unavailable in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All siting and construction decisions remain conceptual; statutory use requires official files and professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are organizer-provided rough substitutes rather than official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Geometry supports package consistency only; all dependent layers and metrics must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: No authorised vibration baseline exists for the three key areas.
assumptions.impact: No exceedance, contour, attenuation distance, threshold or engineering treatment is asserted; unmeasured locations remain U.

assumptions.statement: Official industry and procurement evidence are demand proxies; no test user, platform or operator has committed to the proposal.
assumptions.impact: A real user and written site permission are hard gates before L1.

assumptions.statement: Event attribution is optional and must outperform preregistered non-AI baselines on held-out physical events.
assumptions.impact: Failure deletes the algorithm without changing public access, measurement or operational safeguards.

assumptions.statement: Five public readings are fields to be measured, not promised performance targets.
assumptions.impact: No public improvement means no public-benefit claim and no escalation for display value.

assumptions.statement: Dazhongsi is represented as a multi-level investigation type, not a diagnosed impact location.
assumptions.impact: All local elements remain U until official geometry, structure and measurements are available.

assumptions.statement: No comparable quotations, quantity schedule or approved budget is available.
assumptions.impact: The package gives work packages and escalation gates but no invented total cost.

assumptions.statement: The three submitted building footprints are conceptual envelopes for reversible service typologies, not surveyed existing buildings or approved construction footprints.
assumptions.impact: They support spatial explanation and internal footprint recomputation only; official existing-building, ownership and control data must replace them before siting.

assumptions.statement: Geometry records using this legacy assumption ID refer to the same absent authorised baseline recorded by A-VIBRATION-001.
assumptions.impact: No D/T/S role, E grade, exceedance or treatment may be inferred from the concept geometry alone.

assumptions.statement: Submitted public-continuity and maintenance lines are design principles, not surveyed roads, official redlines or confirmed service routes.
assumptions.impact: Their exact alignment, accessibility, fire and operating conditions require official data and on-site review.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day phasing polygon and schedule are a candidate commissioning container with no confirmed user, permission, site or start date.
assumptions.impact: The clock does not start until L1 role assignment, written permission and a signed professional measurement plan are complete.
